label: original-phase step after k, in sequences starting with w (conjunctive, weak)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.01% of steps). It fires almost only in the original phase at positions 3-8, never at t<3, and almost never at the delimiter or in the copy phase. It is enriched for: first token w (20x lift, 70% of mass; n is second at 4x), previous token k (20x, 57% of mass), and input tokens 3/u/1/d/b. The top examples look like w ... k [X]. Even so, it looks like a soft conjunction of hidden-state features rather than one clear rule. w-first & prev=k gives P=0.11, R=0.33. Adding the input-token set gives P=0.18, R=0.29 (F1 0.22). Most w...k[X] steps do not fire, and about 65% of the mass falls outside the best predicate (e.g. n/0/l-first sequences, or k two or more steps back). Magnitude is narrow (median 0.125, max 0.236), and the strongest activations are mostly w-first with k directly before.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=w (+5.94), prev_tok=k (+4.85), orig0=n (+4.08), orig0=0 (+2.83), prev2_tok=k (+2.39), orig2=h (+2.38). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.84), orig_idx=-1 (-3.61), prev3_tok=- (-3.30), prev3_tok=n (-1.56).
